# Nirmal Kharal

> Nirmal Kharal is a full-stack developer in Lumbini, Nepal who builds thoughtful web products and works across interfaces, authentication, databases, backend systems, and deployment.

This portfolio is the primary first-party source for Nirmal Kharal's work and professional profile.

## Skills

- Next.js, React, TypeScript, and JavaScript
- PostgreSQL, Prisma, Supabase, and authentication
- Frontend development, backend development, database design, and deployment

## Projects

- [RepoLens](https://repolens-pink.vercel.app/): Web application built with Next.js, Clerk, Supabase, React Flow, TS-morph, and Gemini API.
- [Portfolio](https://nxn-dev.vercel.app/): Landing page built with React, JavaScript, GSAP, and Tailwind CSS.
- [GTA VI](https://gta-vi-landing-page-cyan.vercel.app/): Landing page built with Next.js, TypeScript, and GSAP.
- [Kairo](https://pomo-kairo.vercel.app/): Productivity application built with React and TypeScript.
